Title: CHEHAB: Automatic Compiler Code Optimization for Fully Homomorphic Encryption (CC 2026 - Main Conference) - CC 2026
HPCA/CGO/PPoPP/CC 2026 (series) /  CC 2026 (series) /  Main Conference /. ## CHEHAB: Automatic Compiler Code Optimization for Fully Homomorphic Encryption. *Riyadh Baghdadi*, *Abdessamed Seddiki*, *Arab Mohammed*, *Zakaria Hebbal*, *Aimad Chabounia*, *Eduardo Chielle*, *Michail Maniatakos*, *MENACER Djamel Eddine*, *Karima Benatchba*, *Challal Yacine*. **Sat 31 Jan 2026 14:37 - 15:03 at Coogee** - Optimizations for safety and more Chair(s): V Krishna Nandivada. In this paper, we propose CHEHAB, a compiler that automatically vectorizes scalar code, optimizes it, and generates highly efficient code for FHE. CHEHAB supports the optimization of both structured and unstructured code. CHEHAB targets two problems: 1) the vectorization of scalar code and 2) the reduction of instruction latency and noise growth. We evaluate CHEHAB on a set of kernels and compare it to Coyote, a state-of-the-art vectorizing compiler for FHE. We show that CHEHAB generates code that is, on average, 7.38× faster in execution, 2.49× lower in consumed noise, and 251× faster in compilation compared to Coyote (geometric means), enabling CHEHAB to compile larger circuits. ##### New York University Abu Dhabi. ##### New York University Abu Dhabi and Ecole Superieure d'Informatique. ##### Ecole Superieure d'Informatique; New York University Abu Dhabi. | 13:45 - 15:30 | Optimizations for safety and moreMain Conference at Coogee  Chair(s): V Krishna Nandivada IIT Madras |. | 13:45 **26m**  Talk | DiTOX: Fault Detection and Localization in the ONNX Optimizer Main Conference  Nikolaos Louloudakis The University of Edinburgh, Ajitha Rajan The University of Edinburgh |. | 14:37 **26m**  Talk | **CHEHAB: Automatic Compiler Code Optimization for Fully Homomorphic Encryption** Main Conference  Riyadh Baghdadi New York University Abu Dhabi, Abdessamed Seddiki New York University Abu Dhabi and Ecole Superieure d'Informatique, Arab Mohammed New York University Abu Dhabi and Ecole Superieure d'Informatique, Zakaria Hebbal Ecole nationale Supérieure d'Informatique, Aimad Chabounia Ecole Superieure d'Informatique; New York University Abu Dhabi, Eduardo Chielle New York University Abu Dhabi, Michail Maniatakos New York University Abu Dhabi, MENACER Djamel Eddine Ecole Superieure d'Informatique, Karima Benatchba Ecole Nationale Supérieure d'Informatique, Challal Yacine University of Doha for Science and Technology |. | **26m**  Talk | Parallel and Customizable Equality Saturation Main Conference  Jonathan Van der Cruysse McGill University, Abd-El-Aziz Zayed McGill University, Mai Jacob Peng McGill University, Christophe Dubach McGill University |.
